LESSON: READING 4.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: CLASS READERS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.4: Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Readers

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Readers. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: how the main characters make the story flow. What would you consider when selecting a storybook to read?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main characters in a text
2. explain how the characters make the story flow
3. appreciate the role of characters in the class reader

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 4.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: CLASS READERS
This lesson teaches Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Readers for Grade 7 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the main characters in a text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. explain how the characters make the story flow
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the role of characters in the class reader
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Readers using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Readers above.
2. Explain Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Readers to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Readers.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Readers with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Readers important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how the main characters make the story flow. What would you consider when selecting a storybook to read?

SECTION: REMEMBER

2. explain how the characters make the story flow
3. appreciate the role of characters in the class reader
